b1.title: When it comes to content, how do you most want to spend your time?

options.a: I want to visit real filming locations and places linked to works or artists I love
options.b: I want to check out several popular spots around pop-ups and shows
options.c: I want to feel the mood of the work and take photos with my companions

b2.title: What do you most want to do at historic sites?

options.a: I want to listen to the commentary and walk calmly around heritage sites
options.b: I want to try traditional crafts or everyday culture myself and learn in depth
options.c: I want to join easy guided tours or mission-style activities with my family

b3.title: What kind of time do you like best in nature or by the sea?

options.a: I want to stay long in one quiet spot, walking and resting
options.b: I want to visit several viewpoints along the coast and in the forest
options.c: I want to take in the views, talk, and take photos with my companions

b4.title: What are you most looking forward to at restaurants or markets?

options.a: I want to try a variety of the region's signature dishes and market food
options.b: I want to go to restaurants and cafés that are popular right now
options.c: I want a relaxed meal somewhere with a nice atmosphere with my companions

b5.title: What kind of experience do you most want to try?

options.a: I like making or play activities that kids and family can do together
options.b: I want to take on something new or a trending activity
options.c: I want to learn local traditional skills and everyday culture firsthand

b6.title: When you take in night views, how do you most want to spend the time?

options.a: I want to visit several popular night spots
options.b: I want to enjoy the view and make photos and memories with my companions
options.c: I want to rest quietly on a night walking path with few people

b7.title: What do you most want from your time for yourself?

options.a: I want to care for body and mind with a spa or beauty treatment
options.b: I want to shop at my own pace for favorite brands or local products
options.c: I'd rather rest on a quiet walking path or at a rest spot nearby

f1.title: Which experience would you least want to give up on this trip?
f1.help: A few travel types fit you about equally, so we have one more question. If they matter about the same, pick the last option

jejuOwn.title: Jeju is an island — you can’t get there by car alone. Do you live in Jeju?
jejuOwn.resident: Yes, I live in Jeju — car only
jejuOwn.residentNote: Resident — you drive within the island only. With no intercity leg, day 1 starts at your departure time.
jejuOwn.ferryNote: Ship your car on a ferry from Mokpo, Wando, Yeosu or Busan. Pick a port in the ferry timetable below; vehicles usually board 1 hour before departure.

ulleung.title: Ulleungdo is reached only by ferry
ulleung.body: There is no rail, bus or air service to the island, so departure and return are counted only from the four ports with Ulleung sailings. Departure has been set to Pohang Ferry Terminal — switch it to the port you want.
ulleung.foot: Durations are each route’s fixed sailing time plus 40 minutes for boarding. The arrival port varies by sailing (Dodong, Jeodong or Sadong) and crossings can be cancelled in rough weather.

ferry.note: Indicative departures from the mainland. Frequency and times change by weekday, season and weather, and sailings can be cancelled — check the operator timetable before booking.

steps.wide: Pick the long-distance mode first (bus, rail, air, ship, metro, own car). Only matching terminals, stations, airports or ports appear as start/return points.
steps.route: If there are two or more routes (e.g. KTX / express bus), choose one in the prompt. The leg from home to the terminal is included.
steps.local: Choose rental car or public transit for local travel. Set date and start time to get a day-by-day route with travel times; stay time is editable per place.
steps.stay: Stays of one night or more get lodging candidates and booking links per day. Lodging is excluded from sightseeing time.
steps.jeju: Jeju allows air, ship, or own car (residents, or with a ferry) only.
